notes.title: FASTER update now in Beta!
notes.content:
Hey everyone - We've completed our second major update to the game, the FASTER patch! Kind of ironic when it takes us a few months to complete, but quite a few things have happened since our last patch.

1. We've taken back publishing control of our title. Our collaboration with All In Games was great, but their focus shifted to their major titles, with little time for ours. With our future plans, we wanted to take the lead again which means we're once again self-publishing this title.

2. As you may know, the game is also available on consoles. With the next generation coming out, we were waiting to see what impact it might have on our title. So far, we've decided not to do a(nother) visual overhaul, but we have chosen to add a few options that will allow people with a next-gen device to take full advantage of the extra graphical horsepower. You PC people won't have to worry about this too much, but in the course of things, we have further optimized the game, so if you're running on a laptop, the game will likely be smoother for you too!

So here's the changelog for this update:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where additional waves wouldn't spawn when waiting for an objective to complete.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player was unable to hit an object when it was too close.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player was able to shoot through walls with some of the larger guns.
[*]The fourth screen is now used to display player ranking when playing with three players.
[*]Fixed a performance issue during the Victory screen.

[*]Improved hit-box for aliens, making it easier to hit them from or on an incline.
[*]Improved balance for audio, making the music much more audible in many situations.
[*]Improved performance on lower-end devices by optimizing older code.
[*]Improved pick-up visuals, now clearly stating what the item is, allowing users to decide weither the pick it up or not.

[*]Added a QR code to the main menu, linking to the Triangle Studios Discord server.

[*]Steam - Changed controller behavior so that a controller can now be used by a second player instead of always being assigned to the first player.
[*]Steam - Updated the Steam Libraries for this build.
[*]Steam - Fixed an issue where the Steam Controller would not have a Default Configuration assinged to it.
[/list]
And in case you're wondering about changes to other platforms :-)
[list]
[*]PS4 - Fixed a bug where unassigned controllers would not show the white color.
[*]PS4 - Added DualShock4 speaker support.
[*]Xbox - Fixed an issue where the game would not return to title screen after switching user account.
[*]PS4 & Xbox - Added the option to unlock framerate
[*]PS4 & Xbox - Added dynamic scaling, allowing up to 4K resolutions
[/list]

One thing I wanted to point out is something that was mentioned by quite a few people on the community board. An issue has been fixed where a second player was unable to join though the controller, while the primary player was using keyboard and mouse. That should be resolved now.

If you want to help us out, switch to the Beta branch and try out the latest version. We hope you like it! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/trianglestudios]Discord server[/url] if you want to join the conversation and discuss future changes or updates :-)

[h3]Alien Slayers![/h3]Looks like we’re still stuck at home, huh? Not sure how to spend your evenings? We know that many of you prefer to do your team alien killing in person but, as you have probably noticed, we all have to play by different rules for a while. So, until your death-dealing club meets on the same couch again, Steam Remote Play has a solution that will work for everyone.

[*] Open your Friends List and right-click to Invite your friends
[*] They accept the invite in the chat window
[*] Start slaying[/list]
To access your Friends List, you may need to open Steam Overlay (Shift+Tab by default).

Steam Remote Play Together is still quite a new addition to the Steam environment, so its performance may vary across regions. For those of you who experience any issues, we present an alternative.

You can play the classic version of the game (online mode included) by switching to another branch on Steam:
[list][*] Right-click on the game in the Steam Library
[*] Select Properties
[*] Head to the BETAS tab
[*] Choose classic - Original version of the game[/list]

[h3]Hey, everyone! [/h3]It’s been a few weeks since the launch of [i]It came from space and ate our brains[/i] on consoles and our major update on Steam, and we can honestly say we’re thrilled with the response we’ve seen so far. From awesome reviews to funny tweets, [i]It came from space and ate our brains[/i] has been popping up everywhere and we love that.

Today we have some exciting news. We’re announcing our continued support of [i]It came from space and ate our brains[/i], which means we’ll be bringing updates, new content and gameplay throughout the year! We’re planning four major patches titled: Harder, Better, Faster and (wait for it...) Stronger. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/5ee0aa041e024b39a082e716ab11bbf9bbf1f860.png[/img]

If you’re playing the game on Steam, you can help us by switching to the Beta branch, and testing the changes alongside our development team.

While there are over two dozen individual improvements, additions, tweaks and fixes, there are a couple of items that we’d like to highlight:

[h3]How to switch to Beta branch[/h3]Just follow these instructions:
[olist][*]Open your Steam Library
[*]Right-click on It came from space and ate our brains
[*]Select ‘Properties...’
[*]Go to BETAS tab
[*]Select [i]beta - Public beta branch[/i] from the drop-down menu
[*]Wait for the update to download and play![/olist]
[h3]Enjoy and discuss![/h3]Have fun playing the updated version of the game. Please bear in mind that it’s a beta build and you may encounter some bugs. If you do, please report them in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/342620/discussions/6/2137462524936777369/]HARDER - Update 1.1. Open Beta[/url] Steam forum dedicated to the beta. notes.title: Steam Remote Play Together
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/b4394954b0ee8de4c646a07ff61d9a747e4a3b0c.png[/img]

[h3]Hey, alien slayers![/h3]‘It came from space and ate our brains’ is a local co-op game for up to four people. However, with Steam’s new feature—[b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b]—you can play with other people online!

We have prepared a short FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) for you, in which we explain how this feature works, how you can improve its performance, and present alternatives to Steam Remote Play Together. You can find it below.

We hear various reports about the performance of Steam Remote Play Together (it seems to have issues in some regions, especially Asia). It's one of Valve's newest additions to the platform, so hopefully, it will improve with time

The remastered version of ‘It came from space and ate our brains’ is coming later this month. We wish you lots of fun with the game and hope to stay in touch!

We encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CPUcUZc]Discord[/url] too!

Cheers!
All in! Games & Triangle Studios


[h2]FAQ[/h2]Steam Remote Play Together is a brand new feature allowing people to play together online. Please refer to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay/]Steam Remote Play[/url] overview and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=3629-RIAV-1617#networkports]Steam Remote Play Support[/url] for more information in your native language.

[b]Q: How do I use Steam Remote Play Together?[/b]
A: It’s easy! Just follow the three simple steps:
1. Launch ‘It came from space and ate our brains’
2. Open your Friends List and right-click to
Invite your friends.
3. They accept the invite in the chat window and... That’s it!
You're playing together.

To access your Friends List, you may need to open Steam Overlay (Shift+Tab by default).

[b]Q: How does Steam Remote Play work?[/b]
A: Steam Remote Play allows games to be launched on one computer, while being played from other devices connected to Steam. With Remote Play Together, you can invite your Steam Friends to join your local co-op sessions remotely, without having to own or launch the game themselves.

[b]Q: We’re experiencing poor Steam Remote Play Together performance. What can we do?[/b]
A: Below are a few solutions Valve recommends. Please refer to Steam Remote Play overview and Steam Remote Play Support for more information in your native language.
[list][*] Hardware: We recommend a minimum of a quad-core CPU for the computer running the game. The client has more modest requirements, but should have a GPU that supports hardware accelerated H264 decoding. Any recent laptop or PC should meet the client requirements.
[*] Network: We recommend using a wired network for the best streaming experience. People have had some success with powerline networks and wireless N and AC networks with good signal, though your experience may vary.
[*] Game Settings: To improve your streaming experience, you can go into your game settings and lower your resolution and turn off vertical sync.
[*] Steam Settings: In the Remote Play settings you can change a number of things that can affect your experience. You can change your preference for speed vs quality, limit the network bandwidth, and adjust the maximum capture resolution.
[/list]
[b]Q: What network ports does Steam Remote Play use?[/b]
A: Streaming uses UDP ports 27031 and 27036 and TCP ports 27036 and 27037. Please make sure Steam can listen on these ports in your firewall software.

[b]Q: Should I update video drivers?[/b]
A: A number of bugs have been fixed in the latest video driver releases that may affect streaming. If you are getting poor performance, graphical glitches or black screens please make sure you have the latest drivers installed from your video card vendor's website.

[b]Q: What are alternatives to Steam Remote Play Together?[/b]
A: Members of the Steam community have recommended using Parsec, a third-party software, which lets you invite your friends to play games with you online even if the game doesn't have online multiplayer. We don’t officially support this solution, but we hear reports that its performance can be better than Steam Remote Play Together

notes.content:

Who’s the most awesome alien slayer in the entire world? You are, obviously, and now you can prove it! 

[i]It came from space and ate our brains[/i] is a unique arcade top-down shooter that will require you to shoot with guns. But they are not just some ordinary guns, oh no! Those are guns to kill aliens, the guns designed especially to kill aliens, alien-slaying guns. That kind of guns.

We got it covered for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/06e23eb30cf63bf42ad722a4ba0a7de530543a11.jpg[/img]
[b]Pistol[/b] - This is your best friend… at least for the beginning. It’ll help you survive until you can get a new weapon, so treat your pistol well! You didn’t know that you have to start small and underpowered before you can level up? Have you ever played a video game before?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/03d9cad9b45792bba073a7417e62b92bc3bae60c.jpg[/img]
[b]Shotgun[/b] - When you want to spread your message over a wider area, a shotgun is your best bet. Plus, who doesn’t love that “BOOM” sound? It may be short-ranged but it gets the job done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/1f1ab971e51664a57482c9839ac25af5864a8eb5.jpg[/img]
[b]Machine Gun[/b] - One pull of the trigger sends a stream of lead-tipped kisses of pain. It’s fun to put lots of holes in your enemies but can you spare the ammo? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/64534600af862dfa7e2ab13ec4a2437a058e8dd8.jpg[/img]
[b]Plasma Gun[/b] - Need to send a long-distance dedication of death? The Plasma Gun lets you reach out and quickly touch anyone who’s too far away for other weapons.

[b]Laser Gun[/b] - What, you thought a game with space aliens wouldn’t have a laser gun? Come on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7934388/75c87323c0229862a8e41dd60592ef3525043713.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocket Launcher[/b] - Sometimes you just need to blow stuff up. That’s what the Rocket Launcher is for. The shooting speed is low but the explosion is worth it.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.8 - Fixes!
notes.content:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/itcamefromspaceandateourbrains/announcements/detail/94934236315985362]On November 4, 2015 we released a split-screen mode for you and your friends to enjoy.[/url] Today we are bringing you several fixes to make sure you can continue to enjoy slaying all those nasty aliens. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[b]No more dropping through levels[/b]
Several community members reported that they sometimes fell through levels at the beginning of a match. This is now fixed and you should no longer be able to free fall down the map when you join a game in Multiplayer. 

[b]Fixed wrong font in chat for clients[/b]
It was confusing during multiplayer matches to see different fonts being used for the chat. We now made sure that everyone sees and types in the same font. 

[b]Fixed chat over other players scores in multiplayer[/b]
We received multiple comments that it was annoying that the chat-window was being displayed over the scores of other players. This was not intentional, but we made sure that the chat now stays in the right corner.

[b]Password pop-up button fix[/b]
When trying to join a server with a password both buttons said: ‘Cancel’, while one of them was meant to say: ‘Join’. This is now fixed.

[b]Dead camera sound fix[/b]
Whenever you get your brains eaten in a multiplayer match you need to wait 20 seconds before you respawn. Unfortunately, [b]up till now[/b], you were never able to hear the sounds these players were making. This took away your opportunity to enjoy the sounds of dying aliens by the hands of your friends. Now that this is fixed you can once more see how your friends gain super high multipliers because you’re not there to steal their kills! 

[b]Achievements[/b]
The achievements that were tracking your overall progression of completing levels should now all work again. These achievements weren’t unlocking when players tried to unlock: They walked into my gun / Jerrycan / Hardened / Insane in the membrain.

[b]Direct X Update[/b]
We’ve received emails from players reporting that the game would crash on launch. This was solved by updating Direct X. Because of this, we are now forcing a Direct X update check when you launch It came from space, and ate our brains. Should you still experience problems, please send us your crash logs and we’ll make sure to work on further improving your experience.

Finally, we wanted to wish all of you happy holidays!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - New items, settings and awesomeness!
notes.content:
Today we are bringing you all a very cool update that includes some new items and features! The new items we are introducing will increase the survivability of players on higher difficulties and allows more strategic and cooperative gameplay. Let’s start off with the new items that were announced last week and how to use them!

The [i]S.W.A.T. drone[/i] drops care packages from time to time which help players survive and get higher multipliers. In previous versions the drone dropped 3 variants of care packages: coins (yellow), a med-pack (blue) and a temporary weapon upgrade (pink). We have now added a green package that can drop the following items: 

- Shield
- Search lights
- Mines
- And….. [b]Turrets![/b]

These items are classified as [b]‘secondary’[/b] items, which can used on your command by pressing the right mouse button or X on your controller. You can only carry one of these items with you at the same time.  

Besides adding the new package we also redesigned the med-pack (blue package) to work completely different. 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/itempickup.gif[/img] 
[i]Picking up a green care package dropped by the drone![/i]

[h1]Shield[/h1]
With the shield you can protect yourself from all incoming damage for the next 15 seconds, while damaging aliens that are attacking your shield. Use this item to get yourself out of danger! 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/shield.gif[/img]
[i]The shield in action! Protect yourself against incoming aliens![/i]

[h1]Search lights[/h1]
Search lights allow you to deal massive damage to all aliens that step into one of the three lights circling around you for 15 seconds! Use this item to wreck up your multiplier, help your friends in danger or when you are cornered! 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/lightbeams.gif[/img] 
[i]Make sure those aliens get hit by search lights for massive damage![/i] 

[h1]Mines[/h1]
When you have picked up the green package you also have a chance to get landmines that you can place on choke points where a lot of aliens pass through. You will get a total of 3 mines that will explode when an alien walks over it. It will deal massive damage to all aliens standing close to the landmine and you will get the score and multipliers from the kills! 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/mines.gif[/img]
[i]Place up to 3 mines and lure aliens in your trap.[/i]

[h1]Turret[/h1]
A highly requested feature by the community was to add turrets to the game. The only thing we can do is to deliver this item. You can now place turrets at strategic positions throughout the map and get an extra high multiplier, since kills made by the turret count towards your score. The turret has a total of 150 bullets and is ignored by aliens. 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/turret.gif[/img] 
[i]Plant a turret on strategic places in the map and let the points roll in![/i]

[h1]Medic 2.0[/h1]
As stated before, we have redesigned the blue care package dropped by the [i]S.W.A.T. drone[/i]! The medic no longer just gives you +1 HP but allows you to carry the med-pack with you. You can use this medic whenever you   want and when used close to fellow players they will also gain +1 HP! This creates opportunities for a more tactical gameplay session when playing with friends or strangers. Oh, and the best part? You can also use it to [b]resurrect players that are dead[/b]! Just make sure you stand close to your fellow players when you are using this item. 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/healthpack.gif[/img]
[i]The medic bomb will allow you to save you, your friends and the dead![/i]

[h1]Customizable settings[/h1]
Another requested feature by the community is to able to edit more settings, allowing players to tailor the game to their wishes. First of all, we completely revamped the menu, making it more clear what settings can be edited, but from today we also allow players to edit:

[b]The score labels:[/b]
You can now select if you want to display the score labels for every player, only yourself or turn them off completely. 

[b]Damage text:[/b]
You can now select if you want to display the damage your are doing for every player, only yourself or turn them off completely. 

[b]Screen shake:[/b] 
You can now decide how much you want your screen to shake when you are firing guns or are on the move. You can turn the screen shaking off completely, reduce the shake, have it set to normal (how it is now) or make it even more extreme! 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/newmenu.png[/img]

[i]Turning off the score labels and damage text for all players will increase the performance for players that have a low specced PC, since the system doesn’t have to display this information anymore.[/i]

[h1]System improvements & Alien Data[/h1]
We have improved a lot of stuff in the code regarding the network (multiplayer) and alien data. To make a long story short: we have improved the stability of the system, [b]solving major multiplayer issues, networking issues[/b] and made sure that the aliens don’t eat all the performance of the game. The aliens should focus on eating your brain, not your performance! ːcruncherː 

[h1]New achievements![/h1]
With the implementation of new items we are also bringing you a total of 5 new achievements. These achievements are: 

- [b]Hold the Line[/b]: Place 5 turrets.
- [b]Tread Carefully[/b]: Place 15 mines.
- [b]In The Spotlights[/b]: Use the searchlights 5 times.
- [b]Loving My Bubble[/b]: Use the shield 5 times.
- [b]Saving The Day[/b]: Revive 5 people using medkits.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3. - Run for your life
notes.content:
Today we are bringing you all very exciting news! With patch 1.1.3. we are delivering new features and fixes that were requested by the community. 

[h1]Total rebalance of the wave system[/h1]
We have totally rebalanced the way aliens are spawning. This means: 
- All levels have been set to end after 6 waves instead of 8. 
- Sessions are shorter, you can now finish a game on average between 12 and 15 minutes.
- The time between subwaves has been reduced, you will be shooting constantly! 
- Alien HP has been rebalanced. 
- The amount of aliens that spawn during a session have been adjusted. 
- Alien species have been located to their appropriate waves. This means that you won’t be seeing ‘Crunchers’ (also known as tanks) during the first wave. 

[h1]Sprint[/h1]
You now have the ability to sprint for a short duration. After you have depleted your sprint bar it needs a few seconds to recharge before you can use it again. This ability allows you to dodge alien attacks better, maneuver between aliens or rush over to help your friend! The default keybinding for sprint is set to ‘Shift’ or the left trigger if you use a controller. Of course you can bind it to any key in the settings. 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/sprint.gif[/img]

[h1]Block Launchpad[/h1]
As usual we will also release a new map on which you can die like a badass and set a new highscore. This week you will fight of the invaders on a launchpad while it is snowing. Play it alone, or with friends to unlock the Steam achievement  ‘Houston...’ for completing this map on any difficulty. 

[img]http://itcamefromspaceandateourbrains.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Block_Launchpad_SCRN.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
- While using the death cam the audio was not correct, this has been fixed.
- Minor collision fixes across all levels.
- On the map Block City the S.W.A.T. drone now has a better flying route that prevents it from dropping care packages at unreachable locations.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1. - Multiplayer has been fixed!
notes.content:
Hey community! 

We just released a new patch that addresses a lot of multiplayer issues. Besides improving the multiplayer experience we have also fixed/balanced some other stuff in the game. Here is the full list: 

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
We improved the network handling for the multiplayer mode. This allows players to host more stable servers and also allows players to connect to them faster and better. A lot of technical stuff has been done by the developers to make this happen, I got a headache when they explained everything to me. That is why I will just summarize everything into one sentence: [b]Less port forwarding, more alien slaying! [/b]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Particle optimization.
- We have updated the spawn indicators, they now have a new visual effect.
- Fixed the S.W.A.T. drone path in Block City. It sometimes dropped items on objects.
- [Singleplayer] If the player closes the upgrade menu and dies straight after, sometimes the game would get stuck. This has been fixed. 
- Fixed the bridges on the map: Block Countryside. You could get onto the water and aliens were unable to get to you. 

Next week (Monday or Tuesday) we will also announce our plans for new [b]free[/b] content, so stay tuned! 

Please consider leaving us a review on our store page, we would appreciate that!
